verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for a design tool, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Figma's own source is published under any open license. The only GitHub items are ancillary repos (the Code Connect tool and the REST API OpenAPI spec), no license terms are cited, and those repos do not make the core product's source readable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
